name: PpFollowColors
description: Specifies the extent to which the colors in the specified object follow the slide's color scheme.

constants.name: ppFollowColorsMixed
constants.description: The chart colors follow a mixed format of the slide's color scheme.

constants.name: ppFollowColorsNone
constants.description: The chart colors don't follow the slide's color scheme.

constants.name: ppFollowColorsScheme
constants.description: All the colors in the chart follow the slide's color scheme.

constants.name: ppFollowColorsTextAndBackground
constants.description: Only the text and background follow the slide's color scheme.
